name: Foggy Harbor House Blend
short_description: Our signature medium roast: balanced, smooth, and dependable.
description: A crowd-pleasing house blend of Central and South American beans, roasted to a medium profile with notes of milk chocolate, toasted almond, and a clean citrus finish. Roasted in small batches every week at our harbor-side roastery.

name: Sumatra Mandheling Dark Roast
short_description: Bold, earthy, and full-bodied with a syrupy mouthfeel.
description: Wet-hulled beans from the highlands of Sumatra, roasted dark to bring out deep notes of cedar, dark cocoa, and a whisper of pipe tobacco. Low acidity and a heavy body make this a favorite for espresso and cold brew alike.

name: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe Single Origin
short_description: Bright and floral with jasmine and stone-fruit notes.
description: A washed single-origin from the Yirgacheffe region, prized for its delicate florals, bergamot aromatics, and a juicy peach sweetness. Light-medium roast to preserve the lot's natural character.

name: Costa Rican Medium Roast
short_description: Classic, well-rounded, and endlessly drinkable.
description: Supremo-grade beans from the Tarrazú region with caramel sweetness, red-apple acidity, and a nutty finish. A reliable everyday cup that shines in any brew method.

name: Decaf Midnight Harbor
short_description: All the flavor, none of the buzz. Swiss Water decaf.
description: A Swiss Water Process decaf blend roasted medium-dark for a rich, comforting cup with notes of brown sugar and roasted hazelnut. Perfect for an evening pour without the caffeine.

name: Espresso Lighthouse Blend
short_description: Engineered for espresso: sweet crema, chocolatey depth.
description: A purpose-built espresso blend that pulls thick, sweet shots with notes of dark chocolate, dried cherry, and toasted hazelnut. Holds up beautifully under milk for lattes and cappuccinos.

name: Earl Grey Supreme
short_description: Black tea with bergamot and a touch of blue cornflower.
description: A refined take on the classic: full-leaf Ceylon black tea scented with natural bergamot oil and finished with blue cornflower petals. Aromatic, citrusy, and brisk.

name: Jasmine Pearl Green Tea
short_description: Hand-rolled green tea pearls scented with jasmine blossoms.
description: Tender green tea leaves hand-rolled into pearls and layered with fresh jasmine blossoms over several nights. Unfurls into a fragrant, silky cup with a lingering floral sweetness.

name: Himalayan Spring Darjeeling
short_description: First-flush Darjeeling with muscatel character.
description: A first-flush harvest from high-altitude Darjeeling gardens, light and lively with the signature muscatel grape note, delicate astringency, and a golden cup.

name: Moroccan Mint Herbal
short_description: Spearmint and green tea — refreshing hot or iced.
description: A traditional blend of gunpowder green tea and bright spearmint leaves. Cooling, sweet, and invigorating; serve it strong with a little sugar in the Moroccan style.

name: Masala Chai Spice Blend
short_description: Assam black tea with cardamom, ginger, and cinnamon.
description: A warming chai built on malty Assam black tea and a hand-ground spice mix of cardamom, ginger, cinnamon, clove, and black pepper. Made for a rich, milky, stovetop brew.

name: Pour-Over Glass Dripper
short_description: Borosilicate glass cone for clean, bright pour-over coffee.
description: A heat-resistant borosilicate glass dripper with a spiral-ribbed cone for even extraction and a clean cup. Pairs with standard #2 cone filters and sits neatly on most mugs and carafes.

name: Stainless Gooseneck Kettle
short_description: Precision pour spout for total control over your brew.
description: A 1L stainless-steel stovetop kettle with a slender gooseneck spout for a slow, accurate pour. The counterbalanced handle and built-in thermometer make dialing in pour-over a breeze.

name: French Press 8-Cup
short_description: Classic full-immersion brewer in heat-resistant glass.
description: A 34oz French press with a durable borosilicate carafe, stainless frame, and fine three-part filter for a rich, full-bodied cup. Dishwasher safe and built to last.

name: Cast Iron Tetsubin Teapot
short_description: Japanese-style cast iron pot with enamel-lined interior.
description: A 600ml tetsubin-style cast iron teapot with an enamel-lined interior and removable stainless infuser. Retains heat beautifully and makes a striking centerpiece for tea service.

name: Conical Burr Coffee Grinder
short_description: Adjustable burr grinder for consistent grounds.
description: A manual conical burr grinder with 18 click-adjustable settings, from fine espresso to coarse French press. Ceramic burrs keep grounds uniform and your beans cool.

name: Reusable Tea Infuser Basket
short_description: Fine-mesh stainless basket for loose-leaf tea.
description: An extra-fine stainless-steel mesh infuser basket that gives leaves room to expand for a fuller-flavored steep. Fits most mugs and teapots; rinse-and-reuse, no paper waste.

name: Coffee Lover's Gift Box
short_description: Two house roasts, a glass dripper, and filters in a keepsake box.
description: A curated gift set with two of our most popular roasts, a borosilicate pour-over dripper, a pack of filters, and brewing notes — all packed in a reusable keepsake box. Ready to gift.

name: Tea Sampler Gift Set
short_description: Five signature loose-leaf teas with a reusable infuser.
description: A tasting journey through five of our signature loose-leaf teas in resealable tins, paired with a stainless infuser and steeping guide. The perfect introduction for any tea curious friend.

name: The Art of Pour-Over (E-Book)
short_description: Digital guide to dialing in cafe-quality pour-over at home.
description: A downloadable PDF guide covering grind size, water temperature, ratios, and pour technique, with recipes for each of our single-origin coffees. Yours to download instantly after purchase.

name: Online Brewing Masterclass
short_description: Digital video course: espresso, pour-over, and tea steeping.
description: A self-paced digital course with downloadable lessons walking you through espresso extraction, pour-over technique, and proper tea steeping. Includes printable recipe cards and a tasting journal.
